propositions: All four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) currently collect identical coverage instrumentation independently, adding runner occupancy without distinct verdicts since production code has no version-conditional branches.

Coverage tracing incurs measurable wall-time cost (34s median delta per cell) confirmed by A-B-B-A-A-B experiment; eliminating duplicate instrumentation on secondary compatibility cells (3.11/3.12) while retaining behavioral tests reduces aggregate runner use.

Only Ubuntu Python 3.13 should receive coverage flags (--cov and --cov-report) and enforce fail_under; Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 and macOS 3.13 retain both default and integration pytest tiers uninstrumented to preserve compatibility testing.

Workflow contract test must enforce that exactly Ubuntu 3.13 resolves non-empty coverage flags and all other cells resolve to empty string, with defect seeds confirming RED on prior all-Ubuntu condition and zero-coverage condition.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy current workflows each confine coverage collection to one designated cell while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing OSS consensus that selective primary-cell coverage is accepted practice.
